title.narrative: Xinjiang Integrated Urban Development Project

description.narrative: The project will improve urban infrastructure facilities and the environment in the cities of Kelamayi and Kuitun in the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region (XUAR), which will contribute to sustainable economic growth and improve the quality of life for about 340,000 urban residents in the two project cities.

title.narrative: Loan 3017: 100% of contracts awarded and 100% disbursed as of 17 Jun 2022

Progress Toward Outcome: The project physically closed on 30 June 2021. Liquidation of advance account is ongoing. As of 21 September 2021, cumulative contract awards are $80.7million, and cumulative loan disbursement is $85.2million.
Some results are in the Audited Project Financial Statements | Jun 2022: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/45508/45508-002-apfs-en_3.pdf
Some results are in the Initial Environmental Examination | May 2021: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/45508/45508-002-iee-en_1.pdf
Some results are in the Resettlement Plans | Aug 2016: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents//45508-002-rp-03.pdf
Some results are in the Safeguards Due Diligence Reports | May 2018: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/45508/45508-002-sddr-en.pdf
Some results are in the Social Monitoring Reports | Sep 2021: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/45508/45508-002-esmr-zh-hans_2.pdf
Status of Implementation Progress: All works have been completed. Unused loan proceeds will be cancelled upon financial closing of the loan account.
